description: This file defines the GenericDispatcherFactory class which provides implementations for creating and managing LocalDispatcher instances, including an inner class GenericDispatcher that extends the abstract dispatcher. It contains methods for executing services synchronously and asynchronously, enabling/disabling ECA, and managing transactions within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericDispatcherFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and managing LocalDispatcher instances within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericDispatcher
classes.description: Private static inner class that extends GenericAbstractDispatcher, implementing service execution and dispatcher control methods.

methods.name: isEcasDisabled
